test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A @ B means 'A is sister of B'.

A & B means 'A is brother of B'.

 

A # B means 'A is the wife of B'.

 

A^B means 'A is the mother of B'.

 

A + B means 'A is the father of B'.

 

If Z & P + N ^ Q # S & V + E @ L, then which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: P is maternal grandfather of Q.

solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 &
 #
 ^
 +
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: Z & P + N ^ Q # S & V + E @ L

It means: Z is the Brother of P, P is the Father of N, N is the Mother of Q, Q is the wife of S, S is the Brother of V, V is the Father of E, E is the Sister of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ff1c9b4d1cb03406b6a6c4bea81d098b9dfb31db018b62c1315999bf6ae3541.png] 

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) V is father of L - True.

Option 2) Q is mother of E - **False **(Q is the Paternal Aunt of E).

Option 3) P is maternal grandfather of Q - True.

Option 4) N is mother-in-law of S - True.

Here, Option 2 is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
